episodes.title: Bombshell Report on Trump's Ties to Epstein's Trafficking
episodes.description:
We cannot forget or forgive this administration for their cover-up of Epstein’s sex trafficking ring, which 11 women have now tied Donald Trump to.

We need an independent special counsel to investigate and prosecute all of Epstein’s enablers and co-conspirators.
